MATCH (o1:Organization)-[:HAS_CEO]->(p:Person)<-[:HAS_BOARD_MEMBER]-(o2:Organization)
WHERE o1 <> o2
RETURN o1.name AS org1, p.name AS ceo_board_member, o2.name AS org2
details: TypeQL uses not{} but Cypher has no negation

flags.question: Name the first 3 organizations that have at least one board member who is also a CEO of another organization.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (o:Organization)-[:HAS_BOARD_MEMBER]->(p:Person)
WHERE EXISTS {(p)-[:HAS_CEO]-(:Organization)}
RETURN o.name
LIMIT 3
details: TypeQL uses not{} but Cypher has no negation

flags.question: List the top 5 organizations that have a subsidiary in the same city where they are headquartered.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (o:Organization)-[:HAS_SUBSIDIARY]->(s:Organization), 
      (o)-[:IN_CITY]->(c:City)<-[:IN_CITY]-(s)
RETURN o.name AS organization, c.name AS city
LIMIT 5
details: Question asks for top-5 but Cypher has no ORDER BY

flags.question: Name the top 3 articles that discuss organizations with a history of more than 50 years.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (a:Article)-[:MENTIONS]->(o:Organization)
WHERE date(o.foundingDate) < date() - duration('P50Y')
WITH a, o
ORDER BY a.date DESC
LIMIT 3
RETURN a.title AS article, collect(o.name) AS organizations
details: Question mentions threshold 50 but it does not appear in Cypher
Cypher accesses o.foundingDate but "foundingDate" is not a property of :Organization (valid: ['id', 'isDissolved', 'isPublic', 'motto', 'name', 'nbrEmployees', 'revenue', 'summary'])

flags.question: Name the top 3 organizations with the most mentions in articles about technology innovation.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (o:Organization)<-[:MENTIONS]-(a:Article)
WHERE (a)-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(:Chunk)
WITH o, count(a) AS mentionCount
ORDER BY mentionCount DESC
LIMIT 3
RETURN o.name AS organization, mentionCount

flags.question: Which organizations are based in cities not in the 'United States of America'?

flags.question: Name the organizations with the most board members who are also CEOs of other organizations.

WHERE EXISTS {
  (boardMember)-[:HAS_CEO]->(:Organization)
}
WITH o, count(boardMember) AS boardMemberCEOCount
RETURN o.name AS organization, boardMemberCEOCount
ORDER BY boardMemberCEOCount DESC
LIMIT 10
